scope: Pasted discussion and illustrative code; prior runtime evidence is labelled separately

claims.claim: Portable HTML runtimes can shorten delivery and support local execution
claims.evidence: Existing HTML artifacts and prior browser/VFS checks support executable packaging; comparative deployment time is unmeasured
claims.qualification: Cold/warm boot, programming loop and deployment lead time under equal functionality

claims.claim: 0.676% file extension proves compute and energy overhead
claims.evidence: Pasted text associates percentage with added bytes, then reuses it for CPU, latency and energy. Original v74 stress report and measured denominator are absent
claims.qualification: Separate artifact size, CPU time, peak resident memory, energy per completed task and facility consumption

claims.evidence: Browser execution uses the engine and host OS; supplied engineered computer contains v86/WebAssembly markers
claims.qualification: Enumerate host kernel, engine version, emulation/native bridges and device APIs

claims.evidence: Thread/context creation, compilation, memory and messages have costs. Shared memory reduces some copying but adds synchronization duties
claims.qualification: Compare Web Workers, Wasm, native processes, containers and microVMs on the same hardware

claims.claim: Geometric hashes provide unspoofable cryptographic identity
claims.evidence: Hash reproducibility is not possession of a secret key, non-replayability, authorization or independent authenticity
claims.qualification: Keyed authentication/signatures, nonce/replay policy, key custody, verifier and revocation tests

claims.claim: Physical secure boot and FROST signatures are complete
claims.evidence: Controlled extracted-verifier tests accept changed code, added binary and empty directory; provisioning writes MOCK_FROST_SIG
claims.qualification: Pinned trust root, signed canonical manifest, all-file coverage, anti-rollback and fault-injection tests

claims.claim: UI hash labels establish append-only evidence and ISO compliance
claims.evidence: Dictionary overwrites traces by action and truncated digest is labelled EVIDENCE_OK; surface values and witness counts do not verify execution or signatures
claims.qualification: Durable append log, unambiguous encoding, actual I/O observations, full digests/signatures, accessibility/ISO assessment

claims.claim: 1000 TB address lattice constitutes arbitrary physical data storage
claims.evidence: Forward rehydration computes digest/address metadata; it contains no demonstrated arbitrary write/read persistence
claims.qualification: Separate address capacity, procedural generation, backing bytes, arbitrary input preservation, deletion and quota

claims.claim: Half a rack can be shut down and savings begin within a week
claims.evidence: Requires identified dispensable servers, safe migration, equivalent SLA, actual shutdown and lower total-system energy
claims.qualification: Meter rack and endpoints before/after; separate energy onset from financial/carbon payback

claims.claim: Local-first is zero OpEx and requires zero migration
claims.evidence: Endpoint lifecycle, backup, consistency, operations, security, compilation and API dependencies remain
claims.qualification: Costed per-workload migration and total cost of ownership; no general zero-cost promise

claims.claim: Web4 seven layers are a universal IEEE/W3C standard
claims.evidence: Research search locates Marc Herdina SSRN architecture; DID is an independent W3C standard. No IEEE adoption evidence supplied
claims.qualification: Cite specific paper/version and standards conformance separately

claims.claim: Keddeh Koin receipts automatically establish currency settlement
claims.evidence: Work receipts alone do not implement supply rules, independent consensus, double-spend prevention or financial settlement
claims.qualification: Define ledger/reward policy, adversarial consensus, reconciliation and economics independent of mining UI
